trickyParts: What survives an editor rebuild had to live outside the editor: the composer keeps the mark's block id and the index of that reading inside the block, both computed by the editor at selection, and hands them back at the re-anchor. No count crosses the browser-server boundary, and VerifyMark still checks the mark that was written.

Resolution order is now: the live mark, the tracked range, the remembered reading in the remembered block (its last reading when the block now holds fewer; refused when it holds none), then the sole reading in the document when the block is gone.
The refusal tells two cases apart: words that read nowhere were changed or deleted; words still on the page that cannot be placed say so. Each names comment, ask or suggestion.
openQuestions: The reported 'about ten seconds' is still unexplained, as round 1 recorded.
discoveredComplexity: The e2e Postgres is shared with the other roles of this pod: running pg_ctl start against a data directory whose server is already up makes that server shut itself down, which cost one e2e run this round. Check pg_isready before starting it.
